title: $100 a month into AMD since 2016 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into AMD since 2016.
Today that would be worth about {dca:AMD:2016-01-04} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: AMD price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One hundred dollars a month, into AMD, starting in 2016.
Back then, AMD was a struggling chipmaker.
Today, those monthly payments would be worth about {dca:AMD:2016-01-04}.
Small, boring, every month. That's how wealth is built.
